title: Flip Equivalent Binary Trees
summary: Define a flip operation as swapping the left and right child subtrees of any node.
statement: Define a flip operation as swapping the left and right child subtrees of any node. Two binary trees are flip equivalent if we can transform one into the other through a series of such operations. Given the roots of two binary trees, determine if they are flip equivalent.
constraints: A flip swaps a node’s left and right children.
Return whether any set of flips makes the two binary trees identical.
